verdict_plain_words: The full-frame call did repaint the sign to CAFETERIA, but it redrew the whole picture: every region moved (mean abs diff 6.5 outside the sign, 11.8-15.6 inside regions of interest; SSIM 0.71-0.82 nowhere near 1). Faces, the STORE HOURS text, the watermark and background all shifted, and the model returned a different size (2096x1184 WEBP for a 1920x1080 source). The crop composite, by contrast, is byte-identical to the source outside the sign box (0 differing pixels) and only changes the sign interior. That is the point of the comparison: crop-edit-composite localises the repaint; full-frame regeneration does not.
